deck_title: Fermat-Snell stationary least-time optical path vs naive unrefracted straight-line delay rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Pierre de Fermat (1662) Principle of Least Time & Snell stationary optical path law (minimizing optical path length L(x) = n1*d1(x) + n2*d2(x) at the stationary interface point dL/dx = n1*sin(theta1) - n2*sin(theta2) = 0.0000, locking normalized optical path ratio L/L_min = 1.0000x across all 17 cross-interface stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 suboptimal stations) versus naive unbent straight-line connection (which ignores refractive slowdown v = c/n2 and incurs quadratic optical path excess L_naive/L_min = 1 + u up to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step Newton variational action minimization.
